notes.note: Speakers from 0729.bla. Labels are shifted one row: #0.1/#0.33/#0.66 = Tyrant (CHARA_NAME 176), #0.17/#0.34/#0.67 = Ankh (36); #0.2-16 is the 15-variant leader block (all identical).

Leader block #0.18-32 follows Pt_Chara_Check order 13,12,11,15,14,2,1,5,4,3,7,6,10,9,8 = Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius, Black RX, Rider 1, OOO, W, Den-O Sword Form, Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, God. Confirmed by #0.22 (polite = Mebius) and #0.27 (rough = Momotaros). 'Onnen' rendered 'grudges' (prior Tyrant slice used 'grudges').
Ankh asks the leader if they can still fight ('ikeru no ka'); the slice label puts Tyrant here, but the script gives Ankh.

Pair block #0.35-64 = (35+2k, 36+2k) in the same Pt_Chara_Check order: Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius (43/44 polite), RX, Rider 1, OOO, W, Momotaros (53/54 rough), Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, God. Variants differing only in 'we' pronoun (watashi/ore/boku) share one English line. 'Otonashiku' = 'quietly'.
W branch: script shows #0.51 by W (Philip) and #0.52 by W (Shotaro), not #0.52 Philip / #0.53 Shotaro as labelled. #0.53/#0.54 are Den-O Sword Form (Momotaros).
Tyrant's defeat groan after the battle; new roar, no prior English for this Japanese.

Script shows only #0.71 with the leader variable (traced as 00, last of the second Pt_Chara_Check run); #0.72-85 identical alternates. Labels 'Ankh'/'00' on #0.71/#0.75 are not reliable; all identical anyway. #0.68-70 absent from the table.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0729.bla: labels shifted one row (Tyrant #0.1/33/66, Ankh #0.17/34/67; W branch is #0.51 Philip/#0.52 Shotaro). Leader variants from Pt_Chara_Check order 13,12,11,15,14,2,1,5,4,3,7,6,10,9,8. New groan 'Grrrgh...' for Tyrant. No new names (Monster Graveyard already used in earlier slices, not in glossary).
